properties.name: Foundations walk (requirement E)
properties.rationale: Requirement E asks that a conclusion show the chosen principles and givens it ultimately rests on, and that changing one shows what falls. The foundations walk reuses the existing inference chain (PREMISE_OF / CONCLUDES edges) and adds no new edge types. The honest limit is built into the reading: foundations show what follows FROM, never that the axioms are right. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: A conclusion now shows the axioms it rests on: foundations_of walks backward through inference chains to find terminal premises; get_node serves a foundations field with each axiom's truth and the honest limit; a derived relation 'foundations' lists the design's axioms; six integration tests pin the walk.
